question: Give the code of sets have expansion type of 'expansion'?
evidence: code of sets refers to setCode
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
gold: SELECT T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.type = 'expansion' GROUP BY T2.setCode
gold0: SELECT T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.type = 'expansion' GROUP BY T2.setCode

b.request: List the code of every set whose type is 'expansion', including sets that have no matching record in set_translations (i.e., a left join from sets to set_translations on code = setCode, keeping unmatched sets)
b.sql: SELECT s.code FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode WHERE s.type = 'expansion'

d.request: Give the code (setCode) of all sets whose expansion type is 'expansion', and also include those sets that have no matching record in the set_translations table.
d.sql: SELECT code AS setCode FROM sets WHERE type = 'expansion' OR code NOT IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE setCode IS NOT NULL)
